Ordinary Tutor/Authoring constructs complete JSON, calls trusted InputProof.check(body), verifies body and source/config/auth/lease/consent, commits a dispatch reservation before its pinned single HTTP attempt, and rechecks live guards. This text-only path is not Codex/AppServer execution.

CodexProofRegistry accepts only SyntheticCodexProof: explicit_loopback, synthetic-prefixed model IDs, closed synthetic runtime and byte-as-token language. Its destination is /codex-peer/model. These bytes are not a DeepSeek model proof, regardless of official_responses adapter label.

Private retained owner defaults resolver/foreign to None. Explicit fixture composition captures actual SQLite material, provider config and SecretStore snapshot and can retain a limited real Rust-produced request. It rejects unhandled AppServer material. verify expressly proves current source/auth only, not durable-start, transport or model InputProof.

Reuse the existing durable-start seam. Worker admission/auth and jobs claim precede the coordinated provider-start, independent bound witness and lifecycle claim transaction. executor.execute is called after _claim returns and receives a before_request guard for actual started owner/lease/deadline/auth. Default execute is absent; _Gate is synthetic. No SessionExecutor class was confirmed; parent clarified these are the relevant actual production ports.

Fixed SDK local mechanisms can freeze the exact outer Responses JSON and final headers/output limits. FrozenResponsesRequest has an Arc-shared one-use claim; HTTP04 disables proxy, redirect and retries and compares actual built request/body allocation before execution. This is not durable consent, token/deployment proof or exclusion of all AppServer transports. Ordinary EndpointSession reapplies auth/retry and must not be the controlled sender.

Fixed native SDK only permits WireApi::Responses; chat is rejected. It constructs complete history and understands reasoning/custom-tool SSE events. Current DeepSeek official Responses/Codex support removes a categorical protocol blocker, but vendor-ignored flags and semantic differences still require profile qualification. No real account/SSE result was tested.

Ordinary compatible_chat uses max_completion_tokens and admits only role/content/refusal deltas. Official DeepSeek Chat uses max_tokens and defaults to thinking. The sole norm does not grant a Chat max_tokens alias. Existing ordinary Responses explicitly sets reasoning effort none; investigate that existing shape, not an unapproved Chat fallback.

Official fixed recipe is a protocol-aware qualification candidate, never an installed/registered proof here. Its schema ignores unknown top-level fields and historical web_search_call; options ignore that history even in Reject mode. JSON Schema is accepted but ignored. Online API documents different behavior for those cases. Its modified v41 tokenizer derives from an older Vision-Exp revision. Thus unconditional recipe-to-online equivalence is falsified; a narrow subset and online version/framing closure remain unproved.
